verdict.rationale: OCI is a cloud platform, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question. A probe confirms an official MCP server documented at github.com/oracle/mcp, which delivers the core of the story. The evidence is a single existence check with no detail on setup, scope or agent integration. Missing for 10: documentation of which OCI services and tools the server exposes, auth and setup steps for connecting an agent, hosted versus local deployment details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
